thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled router weight update: router-prod v1 -> v2. Start 2026-03-21T16:10:00Z. Plan: 0% -> 10 -> 25 -> 40 (pause 10m) -> 60 -> 85 -> 100. Change window 16:00-17:00 UTC. Runbook: pinning, session drain, backstop CB at 1% errors.
mia: ack, I'll own verification and canary probes. Setting dashboards and alert hooks.
sam: can we confirm session pin strategy? we had stray 502s last time when sessions moved mid-request.
ryan: we'll keep session affinity for existing cookies pinned to v1 for 24h. new sessions go to v2. That should avoid mid-request switches.
mia: copying pin config: `router.config.session_pin = "cookie:rw_v"` — setting cookie TTL 24h.
oncall-sre: add automatic rollback trigger: if error_rate >= 1.0% sustained for 5m OR p95 increases > 2x baseline for 3m. Also circuit-break at 60% weight.
pm-jo: release notes draft pushed to the docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/rls-2026-03-21 — includes model runtime changes and routing pin.
sam: probe list: synth-health (POST /healthcheck), sample user flow (create->query->render), and embedding pipeline smoke.
mia: yes. I'll run synth every 30s during the pause. Baseline p95=120ms, errors 0.15%.
deploy-bot: Rolling 0 -> 10 now.
mia: 10% done. No obvious error uptick. p95 +5ms. :thumbsup:
sam: running smoke — create->query ok.
deploy-bot: Advancing 10 -> 25.
mia: 25% stable. p95 +8ms, errors 0.18%. traces look clean.
ryan: note: EU edge lane shows slight 4xx uptick in logs, investigating.
oncall-sre: scoreboard alerting on EU edge 4xx under investigation threshold (0.4% -> 0.9%). Keep pause at 40.
sam: recommend we decouple EU lane from the cohort and hold it on v1; allow other lanes to continue. That avoids full rollback.
mia: we can do a lane-decouple: set route constraint `region:eu -> weight 0 to v2` temporarily and continue. Anyone object?
ryan: go for it. We should also add a small ramp down for EU to avoid socket resets.
pm-jo: adding note to release notes: "eu lane held at v1 during rollout due to edge validation."
deploy-bot: Applying lane-decouple: region=eu pinned to v1. Progression plan updated: other regions will hit 40(pause) with EU excluded.
mia: Advancing 25 -> 40 (pause). Starting 10m monitor window now.
sam: synth checks running. EU decouple looks good — traffic to EU still served by v1.
oncall-sre: during pause: watch for error_rate, p95, and open connections. If open_conn spikes >20% above baseline for 3min, we rollback.
mia: at +4m into pause: p95 in us/west rose to 180ms (x1.5), errors 0.35% — within SLO. Traces show a slow backend on an autoscaled task, not v2 itself.
ryan: we have one instance of backend svc-translate in scaleup loop, looks like GC pause. Kicked a restart.
mia: restart done. rechecking traces. p95 trending down.
sam: synth flows all green except EU (expected).
oncall-sre: threshold cleared. Suggest we proceed after remaining 6m.
mia: ok — continuing 40 -> 60 -> 85 -> 100 using same ramp timings.
deploy-bot: Advancing 40 -> 60. EU excluded.
mia: 60% reached. p95 stable at 130ms, errors 0.2%. :eyes:
sam: sample user flow shows identical results on v2 payloads.
ryan: re-enable EU lane at 85% step to re-validate, we'll do a slow rejoin: EU v2 weight 5% -> 25% over 10m.
deploy-bot: Advancing 60 -> 85. Rejoining EU at 5% now.
mia: EU rejoin at 5% shows no new 4xx. ramping to 25%.
sam: EU at 25% — all green.
oncall-sre: final checks before 100%: confirm DB connection pools tolerances, cache key compatibility, and logs not showing new error signatures.
mia: confirmed. No schema changes. cache versioning ok.
pm-jo: tagging release note final: rls-2026-03-21-v2 shipped, EU lane transiently held.
deploy-bot: Advancing 85 -> 100.
mia: 100% complete. Post-rollout metrics stable. Closing window.
ryan: will monitor for 1h and revert if anything odd surfaces.
sam: nice — great run. Documenting playbook tweaks from today.
oncall-sre: update: created an incident runbook snippet for region-decoupling (internal link).
mia: thanks team. Adding short POSTmortem notes to the release PR. :party:
